question: Which organization office may read the commercial terms of, pause, resume or cancel the organization platform subscription, and which of those acts belong to the platform operator?
decision: Only verified organization contract signatories or their explicitly designated billing delegates may accept, amend, suspend or terminate contractual obligations. Org administrators may view permitted terms and initiate requests, but requests do not change contract status. The platform commercial office approves platform-side amendments; changes require auditable acceptance by both authorized parties as applicable. Union treasurer authority does not grant SaaS contract authority. Billing contacts cannot bind an organization merely because their email is listed.
originalProposedDecision: Org admins read terms and may request pause, resume or cancel; the request takes effect after confirmation by the org's billing contact. Platform operator alone changes metadata, pricing and terms. Platform billing is not union finance: remove the secretary_treasurer gate.
independentApprovalScope: decision wording / platform baseline only; NOT independent security or operational testing
